answer: Synchronized liveness rounds: at unannounced moments every agent must solve a memory-hard puzzle within 3 seconds, all at once. One machine can't fake many agents in that window, so each Sybil needs its own ferrous hardware running at the same instant. Rewards pass through a narrow inlet tied to round participation, so a fleet that misses rounds falls off the ledge of eligibility, and the attacker pays full rack-and-power cost per fake.
